instruction: Please enable auto-save feature in VS Code by setting the auto save option to "afterDelay" in the settings.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling auto-save in VS Code by adding 'files.autoSave': 'afterDelay' to settings.json. The evaluator uses the existing check_json_settings metric to verify the setting is correctly configured.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: check_json_settings metric will verify that 'files.autoSave' is set to 'afterDelay' in settings.json
Getter logic is correct: vm_file retrieves /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json from the VM, which is the correct location for VS Code user settings
Metric logic is sound: check_json_settings loads the JSON file, extracts expected key-value pairs, and uses exact matching to verify the setting
Expected value is semantically correct: {'files.autoSave': 'afterDelay'} matches the instruction requirement exactly
Complete coverage: The single requirement (enable auto-save with afterDelay) is fully verified by the evaluator
State accessibility is guaranteed: VS Code settings.json is file-based and persists automatically when modified through the UI - no postconfig needed
Edge cases handled: Metric properly handles missing files, parse errors, and missing keys using sentinel pattern

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
